about_the_game:
Build with logic, discover affinities, and relax as you plan your perfect village.

In this minimalist building game with puzzle and strategy elements, every decision matters. On a grid-based map, you must place buildings wisely, taking their affinities into account. Houses near fields? Great. Monuments next to forests? Maybe not the best idea...

With simple rules and a clean look, the game offers a calm experience—perfect for those seeking something relaxing yet challenging. No ticking clock. No pressure. Just you, the map, and your ability to plan and adapt.

Highlights

  • Adjacency logic: each building has positive and negative affinities with others.

  • Puzzle meets strategy: think before placing, and maximize your score.

  • Relaxing and minimalist style: play at your own pace with a clean interface and soothing visuals.

  • Scoring system: challenge yourself and find the most efficient layout.

  • Save and continue later: build your village gradually, no rush.

If you enjoy logic games, building, and a good dose of tranquility, this is the perfect game for you. Get ready to place tiles, explore combinations, and create something beautiful and functional—one block at a time.
